description: Adoption flattens notes/agents.md to content/concepts/agents.md while AGSC-02-90 guarantees the body stays byte-identical, so every relative reference in that body stops resolving. AGSC-02-95 closes the gap without touching a byte: each broken reference is reported as the warning AGSC-E507 naming the original path, the new path and the reference, and each referenced local file that resolves under the adoption root is copied to content/assets/<original-relative-path>. An absolute URL, a fragment-only target and a path escaping the adoption root are left alone and are NOT reported. The warning never errors, so ci stays green on a bare folder (AGSC-02-92).
reason: Withdrawn for 1.0.0 (2026-10-02). The case stated that the AGSC-E507 warnings leave `ci` green on a bare folder; AGSC-02-95 and AGSC-03-11 say the opposite — a reference adoption reports as AGSC-E507 is AGSC-E310 on every later build until the publisher repairs it, so the adopted folder does not pass `ci` — and the reference engine follows them. The case passed through a schema check standing in for `ci`. Superseded by adopt-0009, which runs the real `init` and `ci`.
